skills.name: Finding Common Denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common (least) denominator when the two fractions being subtracted have different denominators.

skills.name: Subtracting Like Fractions
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to get the fractional part of the result.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: Regroup one whole unit into a fraction (borrow) when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than that of the subtrahend.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Conversion
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole Number Operand Handling
skills.definition: Perform subtraction when one operand is a pure whole number (no fractional part) and the other is a fraction or mixed number.
